name: Sea catfish
description: Sea catfishes (Arius heudelotii, A. latiscutatus, A. parkii) - whiskered scavengers-predators of the shallow shelf. Life-stage group of the source's adult and juvenile catfish compartments, measured separately (adults take crustaceans, worms, seabreams and detritus; juveniles sift molluscs and worms), pooled here because the two stanzas form one population.
